findings.issue: Both sessions cannot reach advisory wait: first owns fixture authority FOR UPDATE row lock before scoped advisory wait; second waits for authority row. Two-advisory-wait barrier inevitably times out.
findings.fix: Observe one owned session advisory waiting and other authority row waiting, or reviewed fixture lock arrangement preserving shared authority protocol. Prove overlap without impossible lock order.

findings.issue: Number(v)==='1' always false; lost-response and revocation barriers inevitably time out.
findings.fix: Compare Number(v)===1; independently prove correct barrier behavior.

findings.issue: Parser expects SQLSTATE 42501 literal; psql verbose errors show ERROR: 42501: permission denied; actual permission denials rejected as incorrect.
findings.fix: Parse actual psql verbose SQLSTATE field with bounded permission-error format; test positive permission denial and wrong-state failures.

findings.issue: Hostile service_role invocation evaluates private command_request_hash as service_role, whose EXECUTE is revoked. Fails before RPC invocation.
findings.fix: Compute candidate hash before SET ROLE, supply it as value; retain actual service_role admission call and private helper denials.

findings.issue: Frozen resolver contract available/allowed plus eleven binding fields does not return decisionId; admission requires it. Fixture adds unauthorized fourteenth field and masks incompatibility.
findings.fix: Implement exact frozen resolver contract. Do not silently extend durable authority contract. Reviewed future authority packet must own any new binding.

findings.issue: Merging new SQL path to main automatically triggers production pending-migration application with repository secrets. Inactive route does not prevent SQL application.
findings.fix: Keep engineering migration out of production auto-discovery or implement explicitly reviewed durable migration hold before merge; do not merge current candidate.

findings.issue: Candidate labeled PR head but default checkout tests merge ref; receipt records differing identities without enforcing exact-head requirement.
findings.fix: Checkout explicit approved candidate SHA and assert checkedOutSha equality, or clearly separate merge evidence and add genuine exact-head lane.

observations: Production route remains 503 RUNTIME_NOT_ACTIVE without client creation; production authority resolver deny-only.

Single admission transaction SQL recomputes six-field UTF-8 length-prefixed hash, checks current authority before replay/insertion, atomically inserts five relations; no positive production activation proved.
Security definer fixed search_path, qualified tables, nonlogin owner, RLS, revoked raw DML and restricted admit_run execute seen statically.
Lost-ACK design now discards receipt in DO before commit and intends independent commit visibility; numeric barrier prevents execution proof.
